title: Benchmarking EEG feature families for ADHD research in children and adolescents: performance and explainability across attention tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28299v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder varies in presentation. Diagnosis requires clinical and developmental assessment. Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families and four combinations across attention tasks and assessed the stability of held-out explanations. Two serious games yielded four overlapping attention-task cohorts of 123-140 participants each. Repeated nested participant-held-out evaluation assessed recruitment-group discrimination. Exploratory paired participant-cluster bootstrap tests corrected for multiplicity in two separate families: 72 individual-task contrasts and 18 fusion contrasts. translated_title: 儿童与青少年ADHD研究中脑电（EEG）特征族的基准测试：注意力任务中的性能与可解释性
translated_abstract: 注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）表现形式多样，其诊断需要临床与发展评估。可重现的脑电图（EEG）测量可以补充临床和行为特征描述，但不同的特征定义和评估方法阻碍了研究间的比较。我们在注意力任务中比较了七种特征族和四种组合，并评估了留出样本解释的稳定性。两款严肃游戏产生了四个相互重叠的注意力任务队列，每个队列有123-140名参与者。采用重复的嵌套式参与者留出评估来评估招募组的判别能力。探索性的配对参与者聚类自举检验在两个独立的族中进行了多重比较校正：72个单任务对比和18个融合对比。对于在检查预测结果后选出的八种配置，我们在校准之前解释了留出样本的原始概率。在最强的任务情境中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究对七种EEG特征族及其组合在儿童青少年ADHD注意力任务中的判别性能和解释稳定性进行了系统性基准测试，并揭示了特征族选择与任务情境对性能的显著影响。
en_tdlr: This study systematically benchmarks seven EEG feature families and their combinations for ADHD discrimination in children and adolescents across attention tasks, revealing the significant impact of feature family choice and task context on performance and explanation stability.
